title: Machine learning and biophysical modelling design antibodies with tailored specificity
summary: The study combines high-throughput sequencing of phage display selections with machine learning and biophysical modelling to predict antibody binding profiles against multiple ligands. The model separates binding modes even for chemically very similar ligands, and the authors report experimental validation of designed antibodies with either specific high affinity or cross-specificity. Numbers were not read from the abstract.
